contract: evaluate(cells,army,lost,histories,moves,shuttle) returns pure adjustments/report; lost/histories accepted unused; no persistent state/RNG
gate: one own corner Flag with both adjacent squares own Bombs
exactly one disclosed Miner has finite current stationary-piece route; route >=3 enemy actions
no immediate win or confirmed immediate own Flag attack
route: Classic geometry, own exact ranks, disclosed enemy only, occupancy, exact first-step shuttle; enemy Miner can transit own pieces only if surviving its capture; others fixed
guard: own rank0..7 quiet path to common corner diagonal; rank7 intercept trades. Reject disclosed lethal/exchange attacks against candidate actor or guard path; vacate guard source when computing threats to avoid masking a Scout ray.
schedule: After candidate quiet, no routed Miner => feasible; more than one => uncertified; one => guard d+2<=enemy tau. No arbitrary horizon/weights.
ordering: Preserve all captures. If any quiet candidate is tactically acceptable and schedule-feasible, demote other quiet candidates with scores above best-feasible-score-1 to that floor. All other original scores remain.
bailout: No useful safe quiet alternative => zero adjustments; immediate wins/current confirmed own Flag danger => zero adjustments
limits: snapshot geometry, hidden threats and future other-piece moves ignored
multiple currently routed Miners defer; sequential future breaches can overload guard
no Classic target fit or playing strength claim
measurement: completed C21 screening only, all screened known-Miner roots; actual selected-move override opportunity and monotonic timing; no saved games or validation tuning
